title: 接入、堵塞与同框线索短片
provenance: Original synthetic teaching media created for this demonstration. No uploaded reference, dataset photograph or site footage was used.
observation_guide: 0–<3 秒展示侧壁支管口，3–<6 秒展示管底堆积，6–<9 秒展示右上裂隙及左下堆积同框。
encoding: H.264 in MP4, yuv420p, no audio
editing: Three independently generated scenes joined with hard cuts. Odd shots scale from 1.000 to 1.055; the middle shot scales from 1.055 to 1.000. The upper-left shot marker is a production overlay.
selection_note: The third shot comes from a synthetic still chosen after testing the still with the project detector. The observed still-image scores do not describe this video.
